component.name: MOAS
component.summary: Mouse Orientiertes Adventure System — Mänick Mänschion

description.p: MOAS is a point-and-click adventure system originally written for DOS around 1992–2000. This package is a Linux port using SDL2 that preserves the original game logic while replacing the DOS hardware layer.
The included game data is for Mänick Mänschion.
